entities.name: Pharon
entities.description: A dying Kjeldoran wizard who reveals the Blare of Doom spell.

entities.name: Barrin
entities.description: Scribe who becomes Pharon's successor and renames himself Barrin.

entities.name: Sikrid Veger
entities.description: Dame who tries to bribe the spell from Barrinalo.

entities.name: Blare of Doom
entities.description: An obliteration spell revealed by Pharon.

entities.name: Kylor
entities.description: Elven scout investigating a human settlement at Yavimaya's border.

entities.name: Graddock
entities.description: The Deranged Hermit, who bonds with Yavimaya's squirrels.

entities.name: Wolsey
entities.description: Army scribe who stages a coup among goblins against Jaxle Brey.

entities.name: Jaxle Brey
entities.description: Commander of a human army.

entities.name: Sisay
entities.description: Future captain of the Skyship Weatherlight, who appears as a cabin boy.

entities.name: Tenya Vesh
entities.description: Daughter of elf chieftain Farom Vesh, married to Beric Rycaelin.

entities.name: Beric Rycaelin
entities.description: Son of King Derc Rycaelin.

entities.name: Bo Levar
entities.description: Planeswalker who saved the Eliterates from Yawgmoth's destruction.

entities.name: Destry
entities.description: Actor who impersonates a commanding officer and briefly reigns as Emperor.

entities.name: Balthor Rockfist
entities.description: War veteran who goes to Otaria and forges a sword for Matoc.

entities.name: Matoc
entities.description: Barbarian from the Pardic Mountains of Otaria.

entities.name: Galdan
entities.description: Chieftain of Auror who sets a trial for Balthor.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Planeswalker whose staff supplied the metal for Matoc's sword.

entities.name: Laquatus
entities.description: Traitor whose treachery lets Aboshan's cephalid empire take over the waters of Otaria.

entities.name: Aboshan
entities.description: Ruler of a cephalid empire.

entities.name: Virot Maglan
entities.description: Minor crime-family member whose actions start the Cabal.

entities.name: Kuberr
entities.description: God who grants Virot Maglan's dreams.

entities.name: Cabal
entities.description: Dynasty of evil begun by Virot Maglan's actions.

entities.name: Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria
entities.description: Invasion whose end sends survivors home.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: Plane where the anthology's stories take place.

entities.name: Farom Vesh
entities.description: Influential elf chieftain, father of Tenya Vesh.

events.summary: Pharon reveals the Blare of Doom to scribe Barrinalo and names him successor.
events.quote: He also names the scribe his successor.

events.summary: Sikrid Veger's bribery attempt fails and the scribe renames himself Barrin.
Graddock uses his bond with squirrels to free the elves captured by humans, leaving the camp to its fate.
events.quote: Graddock then uses his bond with the forest's squirrels to free them

events.summary: Captured scribe Wolsey stages a coup among the goblins against Jaxle Brey.
events.quote: allow him to stage a coup and turn on his former commander, Jaxle Brey

events.summary: A cabin boy stowaway aboard a Suq'Ata ship turns out to be Sisay.
events.quote: a cabin boy who turns out to be none other than Sisay

events.summary: Tenya and Beric travel to the spiders' nests and Tenya kills the giant spider.
events.quote: Fenya manages to kill the giant spider and save most of its captives.

events.summary: Bo Levar saves the Eliterates; Destry impersonates an officer and reigns briefly as Emperor.
events.quote: saved by the planeswalker Bo Levar

events.summary: Balthor joins Matoc's tribe and forges Matoc a sword from Urza's staff.
events.quote: Balthor forges a new sword for Matoc

events.summary: Laquatus's treachery lets Aboshan's cephalid empire take over the waters around Otaria.
events.quote: his treachery allows Aboshan and his cephalid empire come to take over the rule the waters around the continent of Otaria

events.summary: The god Kuberr grants Virot Maglan's dreams, starting the Cabal.
events.quote: His dreams are granted by the god Kuberr
